dialogues.speaker: Reveal: Deception of the Starry Sky
dialogues.text: (Written in glaring, glow-in-the-dark ink, the notice is rather unfriendly to the eyes.)

dialogues.speaker: Reveal: Deception of the Starry Sky
Reveal: Deception of the Starry Sky
dialogues.text: This neighborhood is home to an astrologist who prides themselves on a life of "lofty poverty," while actually being the most dangerous individual lurking in Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: Huh? Is this about me? There must be a mistake. This is my family home, and I'm rarely even here.

dialogues.speaker: Reveal: Deception of the Starry Sky
dialogues.text: So, you've finally shown yourself! "B," ally to the infamous "A"... or perhaps I should address you by your proper title, "Old Hag Megistus"?

dialogues.speaker: Reveal: Deception of the Starry Sky
dialogues.text: I've consulted Alice's old manuscripts, though only half a page remains. It says that many years ago, a great astrologist engaged her in an earth-shattering magical duel at the very edge of Teyvat!

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: Who are you calling an old hag!? "Megistus" is a title, a legacy passed down through generations! The astrologist Alice dueled was my master, and she's the real old hag, not me!

dialogues.speaker: Reveal: Deception of the Starry Sky
dialogues.text: Stop making excuses! The real reason you're living in poverty is that you're blowing all your mora on pricey alchemical materials for that forbidden age-reversal magic of yours.

dialogues.speaker: Reveal: Deception of the Starry Sky
dialogues.text: Are you locking yourself away all day because the sunlight would expose how truly decrepit you are?

dialogues.speaker: Reveal: Deception of the Starry Sky
dialogues.text: Quit hiding, you old hag! Step out and answer for your crimes! And while you're at it, you can tear off that painted face of yours too. I know that you're actually several hundred years old!

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: I am still young, mind you, this is natural collagen, nor some dark sorcery! I am poor because I just bought myself the newest astrolabe! And I've told you a thousand times, I don't live here! Of course I'm not coming out!

dialogues.speaker: Reveal: Deception of the Starry Sky
dialogues.text: I speak for the enlightened few, and this is your last warning. Identify your associates, "B"! Stop hiding, I know for a fact that you're home!

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: Whatever. Why should I even bother explaining myself to a brat who doodles with a glow-in-the-dark pen?

dialogues.speaker: Message From the Knights of Favonius
dialogues.text: Miss Mona, we have received your report. The child who was yelling about the "filth of the adult world" while attempting to pick the lock has been picked up by Mr. Albedo.

dialogues.speaker: Message From the Knights of Favonius
dialogues.text: You may deal with this notice as you see fit. Furthermore, we regret to inform you that the Knights of Favonius are unable to reimburse you for expenses incurred from removing the fluorescent pigment.
